fieldValues.title: A person working with AI in Evidence-backed writing
fieldValues.summary: The writer as the director of agents: they must share their assumptions and boundaries so agents respond usefully and never take over the writing.
goals: Agents respond where the writer is working and never write the text
Agent feedback stays readable and has a stopping point
Easy AI drafting does not pull the writer away from writing
jobs: Say which stance and role each agent plays
Scope what an agent may look at and respond to
Check an agent's response against intent
Keep an abandoned framing an agent cannot re-derive
fieldValues.needs: Agent roles declared once and read by every agent, feedback that does not outrun reading, and a clear line between the writer's words and agent responses.
